description_en: Retrieves the details of a VPC firewall for a transit router
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-tr-firewalls-v2-detail --lang zh --firewall-id vfw-tr-a5a6b89f467649280000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrFirewallsV2Detail

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.
> FirewallId is required. If this parameter is not specified, ErrorParameters(400) is returned. You can call DescribeTrFirewallsV2List to query existing FirewallId values. If no VPC firewall exists, create a CEN instance and a transit router first, and then call CreateTrFirewallV2 to obtain a FirewallId
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙实例ID。
> FirewallId 实际为必填项，未提供返回 ErrorParameters(400)。可通过 DescribeTrFirewallsV2List 查询已有 FirewallId；若无则需先建 CEN+TR，再经 CreateTrFirewallV2 获取 FirewallId
parameters.name: firewall_id
